title: Popup Farbling
description: Tests whether Brave's fingerprinting farbling applies inside popups. With Shields up and fingerprinting protection on, eleven surfaces are read in the opener, in a blank popup from window.open(''), and in a popup from a blob: URL. The blank popup reports the device's real values while the opener reports randomized ones. A control run reads the blank popup's values from the opener first, which returns them randomized, so the outcome depends on which page reads first.
